text:
maria: FYI partner EdgeFoundry wants a formal webhook SLA for the embedded SDK usage fingerprinting flow. They asked for 99.9% delivery within 30s for live pings and a 7d backfill window for retries. Can infra support replay + DLQ? @jamie @sana

alex: Quick Qs — what peak QPS should we plan for, and can we get a sample payload so integrations team can wire a test harness? Any dedupe or ordering semantics?

maria: Peak expected ~250 r/s, steady-state ~20 r/s. They will send per-instance pings with these fields: instance_id, ts, usage_tokens, event_id, signature. Example payload below.

```json
{"instance_id":"ef-abc123","ts":1719810000,"usage_tokens":54,"event_id":"evt-001","signature":"hmac256:abcdef..."}
```

sana: Ingestion side notes: we require idempotency via event_id + signature (HMAC using partner secret). 7d TTL for replay is feasible but affects storage/cost — recommend DLQ -> S3 replay pattern. Also request rotation windows for partner keys (support old keys for 24h).

jamie: Implementation notes from infra: we can meet 30s ack SLA if they are on Dedicated capacity or routed to our nearline low-latency pool. Hosted (shared) path would be best-effort (SLA ~95% for 30s). Sustained 250 r/s will push us into reserved throughput/auto-scale rules — we should scope it as a Dedicated offering with DLQ + S3 replay. Also need to size the ingestion cluster for peak bursts (x2 headroom). @maria please confirm which product tier they expect.

oliver: Heads-up — partner legal will require a crediting and outage/backfill clause (how credits calculated if data lost). They also asked for an integration checklist + end-to-end test harness. I'll draft the contractual language.

maria: Action items:
- @alex: create test payload harness + provide a shared webhook endpoint and sample replay tool (due EOD Wed)
- @jamie: confirm infra cost/ops estimate for 7d retention + DLQ and sizing for 250 r/s (due Thu)
- @oliver: draft contract clause & integration checklist (due Fri)
- @sana: author verification + replay runbook (incl. key rotation) and add idempotency tests (due Fri)

Test harness repo: https://git.redwood.internal/edgefoundry/integration-tests (internal)

ingest-bot: TEST_DELIVERY evt-001 received 1719813600 status: delivered :white_check_mark:

maria: Great — scheduling sync Thu 11:00am PT. Please add notes to the repo and ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
